_comment: ZCode MCP descriptor (ADR-0042) — MANUAL FALLBACK ONLY. The PRIMARY wiring is the plugin's own .mcp.json: ZCode expands ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} for plugin-provided servers and auto-connects them, so a marketplace-installed plugin needs NO entry here. Merge this server into ~/.zcode/cli/config.json at mcp.servers.skill-search ONLY when the plugin layer is unavailable (e.g. a desktop-managed MCP list overrides files) — config-file servers never expand templates, hence absolute paths. Do not run both layers deliberately for the same server. Env block is kept in strict lockstep with .mcp.json (scripts/check_mcp_env_parity.py); SKILL_SERVER_RECORDS is omitted here deliberately — the engine's Path.home() default resolves the same directory without a machine-pinned literal.
